name: Gemini Notebook
summary: AI research assistant from Google that turns your documents into slide decks, mind maps, audio overviews and video overviews.
description: Research and note-taking assistant built on Gemini models and grounded in the sources you add. You can chat with a notebook and generate mind maps, slide decks, reports, audio overviews and video overviews. The Standard tier is free; Plus, Pro and Ultra upgrades come through Google AI plans.
contains: turns files into slide decks, mind maps, reports, audio overviews and video overviews
chat grounded in the sources you add
free Standard tier; Plus, Pro and Ultra via Google AI plans
web app with sign-in plus a downloadable app
built on the latest Gemini models
